title: Tronian Rhotron Pro 510 Battery
description:
The Tronian Rhotron Pro redefines portable vaporization with precision engineering and intuitive innovation, merging power, customization, and durability into a compact 510-thread battery. Designed for both newcomers and seasoned enthusiasts, it elevates every session with advanced functionality, offering real-time control and unmatched versatility.

The Rhotron Pro features a vivid OLED display at its core—a significant upgrade from the original model’s basic LED indicators. This screen delivers real-time insights into your session, including voltage output (1.6V–4.2V), cartridge resistance, a puff counter, and battery percentage. Whether verifying cartridge compatibility or tracking usage, the OLED interface ensures full transparency, empowering you to optimize every draw.

Features:
Budget Friendly: High Quality 510 thread battery at an affordable price.
OLED Display: Track sessions in real-time with a vivid resistance, puff, and battery readout.
Adjustable Voltage Control: Fine-tune output from 1.6V (flavor-focused) to 4.2V (intense vapor).
Cartridge Resistance Display: Compatible with almost all cartridges. Features a cartridge compatibility counter on the screen.
USB-C Charging: Recharge the 400mAh battery fully in 60 minutes with modern rapid charging.
Puff Counter: Monitor usage effortlessly with an upgraded session-tracking feature.
15-Second Pre-Heat Function: Prepare materials instantly at 1.8V±0.15V for smooth draws.
Compact & Lightweight: Sleek 63mm x 20mm design weighing just 24g for on-the-go use.
Easy-Clean Design: Compatible with Zeus Purify tools for hassle-free maintenance.

Cartridge Not Included

Purposefully cable-free. Most clients have a USB-C cable already. No clutter, no waste. If you need one — we’ve got options.

Precision meets flexibility with the Rhotron Pro’s fully adjustable voltage control in 0.1V increments via dedicated +/- buttons. Unlike the original Rhotron’s four preset voltages, the Pro lets you fine-tune settings from 1.6V for delicate flavor preservation to 4.2V for dense vapor production. The Rhotron Pro also has a 15-second pre-heat function that helps prime materials for more consistent performance.
